02 — About

Behavior is the interface.

I’m Jack — an Eagle Scout with a Bachelor’s in Psychology and a minor in Sociology. In my senior year I pointed that human-behavior foundation at User Experience: an international research & design program, then BCS UX and IBM Data Science certifications.

My edge is reading people. I start with research — interviews, journey maps, usability tests — and let the evidence drive intuitive, integrated design across digital and physical experiences.

A grandmother with macular degeneration is why accessibility isn’t a checkbox to me — it’s the point.
